text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: —Haaaaahhh!!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
—How was that?! Did it move your heart 
today? 
I put way more spirit into it than 
yesterday, right?!

text_block_list.name: Beauty Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Yes... more than that, even. 
You girls are beauty itself. But...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Still far from an inspiration... is that 
it? 
Even so, I'm not gonna give up!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
I want you to remember it too, Beauty-san. 
Just how huge the reward is on the other 
side of all that pain!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Besides... I know how badass your racing 
silks are! 
I wanna see them again! That's why I'm not 
giving up!

text_block_list.name: Beauty Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text: ...Vodka-chan...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
—Haa, haa... 
Grrr... What even is inspiration 
anyway...?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
I don't get it, but all I can do is run... 
I won't lose! I'm gonna show her that I 
can overcome it too...!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
And then, I'll definitely reach 
Beauty-san's heart... Whoa! 
Hishi Ama-senpai, when did you get here?!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Hahaha! Didn't even notice me getting this 
close, huh? 
That's some good focus.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Heheh, yeah! I'm done whining! 
...Alright, one more lap—!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
—Did you see that, Beauty-san? 
That was a masterpiece of a run, wasn't 
it? Did anything click with you?

text_block_list.name: Beauty Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text: ...Non.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Aw. So harsh. 
Is that all for today? We'll take our 
revenge again tomorrow.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Hold on! We can't keep saying 'tomorrow' 
forever, can we?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Please, just look at me one last time.

text_block_list.name: Beauty Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Thank you... You are all so beautiful. 
But my heart is already set as hard as 
stone...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
No... we don't know that yet. I mean, 
Beauty-san, 
you've been going along with all this, 
haven't you?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
You're looking for inspiration in us. 
Doesn't that prove you haven't given up?

text_block_list.name: Beauty Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text: That's... just sophistry. I'm already...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Beauty-san... I was just like you. 
Suddenly I couldn't win anymore, it hurt 
so bad... and my mental state completely 
crashed.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
But... I came back. That's why I know. 
You're definitely gonna be able to draw 
again, too!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
You're trying to break through your wall 
right now! 
...So—!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
—Remember it! That thing called passion! 
I'm gonna show you what running with 
everything you've got looks likeee!!!

text_block_list.name: Beauty Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Ah...! She's completely different from how 
she was before... 
Is this... her true self now that she's 
rekindled her passion...?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
—*Pant*, *pant*...! 
—*Pant*, *pant*...!

text_block_list.name: Beauty Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
What sheer beauty... Ah, watching someone 
get back on their feet is so 
breathtakingly beautiful. 
I wonder... is that beauty something I 
could never grasp?

text_block_list.name: Beauty Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
No, I know what it feels like to fall. So 
all that's left is to rise again, right? 
I want to... grasp it too. Because the 
sight of rising up is just so beautiful.

text_block_list.name: Beauty Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
I want to create! An outfit worthy of that 
radiance—! 
—Ah...!!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
—Goal! Heheh! I looked pretty cool, didn't 
I? 
Hey, Beauty-sa... n?

text_block_list.name: Beauty Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text: BEAUTYYY!!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Huh!?

text_block_list.name: Beauty Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Ah! This is it! Taking those wild, 
powerful legs rising boldly in the 
wilderness and wrapping them in pure 
elegance...! Quick! I have to sketch this 
down right nowww!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Ah, hey, where are you going?! Could it 
be...! 
Is she really back?! After her, everyone!

text_block_list.name: Beauty Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
......! Ah... no, it's no good...! 
Because... I already "threw them away"...!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Threw them away? Ah! 
Could you mean... back when I brought over 
that midnight snack...?

text_block_list.name: Beauty Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
I realized it too late. 
Just when inspiration struck, how could 
this be? I'm completely disqualified as a 
designer.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: It's not too late at all!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Is this what you're looking for?

text_block_list.name: Beauty Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
That's...! Ahhh! 
My "tools of the trade" that I threw 
away...! Even my unfinished sketches...!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
When I went in to clean, they were in the 
trash can, so I quietly kept them safe. I 
didn't want you to... end up regretting 
it.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
When did you manage to do that?! Hahaha, 
that's our Flower for ya! 
...That's right! You can start over as 
many times as it takes! Here, use them!

text_block_list.name: Beauty Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
You guysss...! U-Urrrgh... I finally 
understand. 
I could never forget it! The absolute 
ecstasy of the moment you bring your 
finest masterpiece to life!

text_block_list.name: Beauty Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
I want to grasp beauty once more...! 
So...! UOOOOOOHHHH—!!

text_block_list.name: Beauty Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
I drew it! Ah! Ahhh, geez! 
I want to make it right this second! I'm 
going back to the atelierrr!!!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Sounds good! Go for it! Since we've come 
this far, we're sticking with you!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, the group hurried back to the 
atelier. 
Beauty Anshinzawa set to work with 
blinding speed—

text_block_list.name: Beauty Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Kyahaha☆ This is it, this is IT! Beauty! 
This is so much funnn!! 
Are you guys done cutting the fabric 
yet~?! The next pattern is almost 
readyyy!!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Done and done! 
Oh, what should we do about the lining? 
Just give me the word and I'll take care 
of it!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Beauty-san is totally in the zone. Very 
good, very good. 
Leave the intricate decorations to 
Ma-chan. I'm well-practiced from making 
dolls.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Whoa-whoa-whoa, where am I supposed to cut 
this from and to where?! It's so silky the 
scissors keep slipping...!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Ah, you didn't leave a seam allowance, did 
you! 
Look, you gotta cut outside this line... 
just like this!

text_block_list.name: Beauty Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Oh my? If I tweak this scrapped design, it 
actually totally works! 
Ah... my failures and my aimless 
wandering, they were all part of my story 
all along, weren't they...?

text_block_list.name: Beauty Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
If I had thrown them away, this beauty 
would have been lost forever. 
Thank you. For saving them!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Fufufu, I'm glad I wasn't just being 
meddlesome. 
Time spent in a slump is never wasted 
after all, is it...!

text_block_list.name: Beauty Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
—That's the first two done! Time for a 
fitting right away♪

text_block_list.name: Beauty Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Très biiien☆ The color palette is simply 
superb~! 
It is utterly beautifuuul!!!

text_block_list.name: Beauty Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Even I'm captivated by how well this 
turned out! Ahhh... 
I've brought yet another piece of beauty 
into this world...♡
